title: Regional Product Sustainability Specialist
description:
Our goals - Your path

We're looking for a Regional Product Sustainability Specialist to join our organization. In this role, you will lead sustainability initiatives across our product portfolio, driving meaningful environmental impact while ensuring compliance with regional standards. You will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to integrate sustainability into our product development processes and help shape our organization's commitment to responsible business practices.

* Implements and documents product sustainability analyses, evaluations, and case studies for Sika in support of Sika’s net zero roadmap and within the context of local, regional and global key projects
* Performs Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) and develop Product Carbon Footprints (PCF)/Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) for products, in accordance with ISO 14040/44, ISO 140647, ISO14025, EN 15804, or other relevant standards
* Key focus is on Target Market related Sustainability initiatives including PLS projects/PCF/LCA/EPD for customers
* Support TM with customer requests related to products labels and certificates (EPDs, LEED attestation, Green Building programs, ...)
* Works with product sustainability software/platform (such as Stibo for PCF automation, EMIDAT tool for EPD automation/avoided emission, LCA FE, SikaNOW, IBU, EDMS, and others as relevant)
* Acts as expert/point-of-contact for inquiries related to the SPM methodology within Target Markets
* Supports regional and local teams with sustainability aspects in PCP processes
* Reports and communicates results of sustainability evaluations to other experts and stakeholders within Sika

Suitable candidate will join the APAC Sustainability Team and become part of Sika’s global sustainability community. The incumbent will lead projects or participate as project team members and serve as consultants to Target Markets and external stakeholders.

Your expertise - Our strength

***Qualifications/Experience/Education***

* BSc or above with professional qualification in sustainability, environmental science, chemical engineering or other related Engineering field
* Knowledge on Scope 3 emissions, Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Product Carbon Footprint (PCF), Environmental Product Declaration (EPD)/ Green Building Certification Programs
* 0-3 years working experience with customers and understand about voice of customers
* 0-5 years’ experience in the Construction Chemical Industry/ or other relevant industry
* Experience with ISO 14001/ ISO 50001/ISO9001 is a plus
* Structured, collaborative way of working with good team-working skills
* Innovative problem-solving ability and critical thinking skills
* Good oral and written communication skills in English; Japanese is a plus
* Motivation to drive and contribute to Sika’s sustainability journey and work in an international environment
* Good project management skills
* Willingness for moderate travel-most within APAC but occasionally may be out of the region

Going Beyond. Together.

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

description:
**[What the role is]**

As part of the Sustainability Office, you will help promote Singapore’s aviation interests to sustain the long-term competitiveness of the Singapore air hub. This will involve overseeing and coordinating matters relating to aviation environmental protection and supporting the development and implementation of sustainability roadmaps for domestic airport emissions and international aviation emissions.

**[What you will be working on]**

You will analyze global aviation trends and monitor broader environmental developments to refine and implement CAAS’ sustainability strategy for the Airport, Airline and Air Traffic Management domains as laid out in the Singapore Sustainable Air Hub Blueprint. You will also align policy positions across various CAAS divisions, and other government agencies handling issues with environmental implications. You will also analyze and provide recommendations on key aviation environmental issues discussed at the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and regional bodies like ASEAN. You will work closely with our aviation stakeholders to support the development of these policies, and in their implementation.

To succeed in this job, you should have good interpersonal skills to engage stakeholders on aviation and environmental issues. You should have strong thinking skills and analytical skills to sense-make underlying trends and developments from both structured and unstructured information sources. You should also be interested in international affairs and aviation climate change related issues.

**[What we are looking for]**

* Background in Environmental Studies/Sciences, Engineering, Business, Economics or Geography preferred
* 10 or more years of work experience
* Prior relevant environment or aviation-related experience would be an advantage
* Good team player with excellent verbal, written communication and analytical skills
* Self-motivated and independent, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment
* Able to travel on occasion for work

Note: Your appointment designation will commensurate with your relevant work experience. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance and may be considered for placement on a permanent tenure or subsequent contract renewal.
